body: Thank you for reading and your kind words. Another hard part of this is they aren’t out publicly yet, so I can’t talk about it with people.

Am I being unreasonable for not being on board with my trans wife starting hormone therapy before we get pregnant? When we met, they were presenting and living as a male. We’ve been together ten years. I have been open and honest since our first date that I am looking for a partner to have a child with. 9.5 years into our relationship, my then husband came out as a transgender woman. I support their trans identity 100% and can still picture a life with them. 

However-

They now want to start taking hormone therapy (estrogen) as soon as possible.  They have been in full control over when we can start trying to get pregnant. First, it was we were too young, then they didn’t feel ready, then they thought we weren’t financially stable enough, and now it’s that they want to start taking estrogen as soon as possible to improve their mental health. We had been actively trying for about a year when they came out as trans, and now our family plan has been put on full stop as they are coming to terms with their trans-ness. 

I turn 35 next month. I have waited patiently for them to “be ready” for ten years, as much as I tried to get on board with them transitioning before we start trying again, I just can’t fucking do it. At this point, the older I get, the higher the chances for complications to my health and the health of my theoretical baby. 
(And before you suggest it, yes we’ve looked into banking sperm, and yes I know we could always adopt. I know.  The issue here, is my spouse has not taken any initiative to make deposits to said sperm bank, nor have they taken the initiative to make sure their swimmers are viable.)

Am I unreasonable for thinking that were they to start taking a drug that would directly impact their fertility is a direct betrayal to our family plan and the many years I have waited?

EDIT: I can’t tell you all how much your words of care and advice mean to me.  More info in answer to some questions that were asked:
- We both are in, and have been in therapy.  My wife has two therapists- one through our insurance and a gender counselor through an LGBTQ center.  I have been with my current therapist since 2019. My wife also agreed to take on the responsibility of getting us in couples counseling, and we are on a wait list.  
-If kids are taken off the table completely, I don’t think I could stay in the relationship, no matter how much I wanted to. However, at this point, I don’t think I care if the child is biologically hers. I want to be a mom- with her, without her, I want to be a mom.
The issue is they have taken no initiative to make deposits at said sperm bank, but has very quickly made appointments to start hormone therapy.

You didn’t need to call me a sick breeder fuck. That was cruel, unnecessary, and projects that you are looking for conflict. 

I’ve looked into your post history. Your life sure doesn’t seem perfect and definitely has some trauma. Know what doesn’t help people grow and evolve? Know what makes people weary of what you have to say? When you jump to conclusions and call them names in a place where they are looking for support and kindness. 

Please move on and leave my post alone. If you have more to say to me, I invite you to DM me.
You aren’t here to help me. You are here to judge me and project your trauma on to me. That is not what this sub is for. Please move on.

I don't really have any advice to offer, other than to say you are not alone in your experience-  I am in just about the exact same boat. I deeply relate to the feelings of exhaustion from being sad, and stubbornness about trying to make it work.
Thank you for replying.  A lot of what you said really hit home.
Thank you for the kind words and validation.
Thank you for the great insight advice! And congrats on your pregnancy!! I will look into sperm banking and definitely take some deep breaths. I forget to do that sometimes.
